name: jack split crunches
description: A crunch with legs that split apart like a jumping jack while lying down. It trains the abs and keeps the legs working.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead and legs together.
Lift your shoulders and legs as you crunch up.
Open your legs wide in a split while your hands reach forward.
Bring the legs back together as you lower.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Repeat at a smooth, steady pace.
